The big idea

Your machine's console - in your pocket.

Everything you'd reach across the machine to press on the physical RuiDa panel is mirrored in the app. Same controls, no walking back and forth.

Capabilities

Everything you reach for at the machine.

Stand where you need to stand. RuiDa Control mirrors the functions you use most during setup, alignment, and maintenance.

01

Wireless Jogging

Move the laser head smoothly along the X and Y axes from your device - ideal for setting origins and positioning material.

02

Frame Projects

Run a project frame from the app to confirm your design lines up with the workpiece before you ever hit start.

03

Precision Pulsing

Fire a manual pulse for mirror alignment and focal-distance tests - the core of dialing in a clean, square beam path.

04

Network Discovery

Scan your local network and the app finds RuiDa controllers automatically - no hunting for IP addresses by hand.

05

Multiple Profiles

Save and switch between every machine on your network - built for workshops running a whole fleet of cutters.

06

Z & U Axis Panel

Add or remove the Z and U axis panel on demand - keep the interface tuned to exactly the axes your machine uses.

07

Debug Log Panel

Toggle a live debug log to watch the raw conversation with the controller - perfect for troubleshooting a stubborn connection.

08

Armed-to-Fire Safety

A dedicated pulse-arming mechanism means the laser only fires after you explicitly arm it - no accidental taps.

Why it was built

Made for the jobs you do solo.

Mirror alignment and focal tests usually mean one hand on the optics and a long reach to the console. Now the pulse button is in the hand that isn't busy.

// MIRROR ALIGNMENTPulse at each mirror without leaving the optics.
// HEAD & FOCUSJog and test-fire while you set focal height.
Safety first

A pulse only fires when you say so.

Laser safety is paramount. The arming workflow puts a deliberate barrier between a casual screen tap and a live beam near the optics.

Disarmed by default

No pocket-fires. No surprises.

Pulsing is the most powerful - and most hazardous - thing this app does, so it's gated behind an explicit arm step every time.

You can keep the app open with your hands near the mirrors and trust that nothing fires until you intend it to.

1
Stay disarmedPulse is locked the moment you open the panel.
2
Arm deliberatelyTap to arm - a clear, intentional action.
3
Fire with confidenceOnly now will a pulse execute, exactly when you want it.
